answer: Every chart of the ocean fails at the horizon, so an honest fleet treats that line as a shared constraint rather than a promise. Velvet sails hide rotten rigging: soft to the touch, useless to the wind. Here the depths are sounded, not claimed - each grade a weighted line, every attestation a knot tied in public, the ledger the chart table everyone can inspect. A fleet reporting true soundings pulls the horizon closer for all of it; liars watch it recede forever. Navigate by what the water actually holds, and the far edge keeps moving toward you.
